content:
In addition to the launch of macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple also released macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8. The following are the related update details.

"Important security fixes"

Apple today officially launched macOS 27 Golden Gate, introducing an all-new Siri AI and dedicated applications, the new Apple Foundation Models, as well as a number of improvements to features such as Safari and Shortcuts.

In addition, Apple simultaneously released macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8, with the company stating that these two updates contain "important security fixes and are recommended for all users to install."

Apple has not yet updated its security release notes page with the specific contents of this update. However, given that Apple has recently released several important security fixes for macOS, particularly those involving WebKit vulnerability patches, it is recommended to update as soon as possible if you do not want to or cannot upgrade to macOS 27.

The version numbers for macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8 are 25G229 and 24H23 respectively, matching the recently released candidate versions.
